text: CURRENT M16 reception is ONE shared 2,600 t/h envelope, not 2 × 2,600 t/h. CURRENT reception is a single 2,600 t/h path (M16A-A-T01 → T02 → T03/T04 → the three stacker lines): PRO-0001 §2.1.1 puts auto sampler M16VP01 on M16A-A-T01 and M16VP02 on 'the adjacent future conveyor', and PFD-0001[3] marks that adjacent line FUTURE. C1 and C2 therefore share one reception envelope — aggregate current reception is capped at 2,600 t/h, never 2 × 2,600 t/h. Modelled as a shared-capacity group on every stacking leg, so total stacking at M16 cannot exceed 2,600 t/h in a bucket whichever corridor the material came from. CONSEQUENCE: the S3 initial in-transit profile shows the corridors running alternately (C1 arrivals in the buckets C2 leaves free) instead of both at full rate in the same bucket — the alternation is DERIVED from this envelope, not observed dispatch history. A structural cap on simultaneous corridor dispatch, plus any reception buffer/interlock, still needs route evidence.
